'''sniper222 What's this!!! Bounty hunters in the Death Star!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[sniper222]]
* '''Published:''' 21 September 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star|ANH-D-deathstar.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 DeathStar sniper222 DS 2004 5832.txt |Download]] (omits Retract The Bridge: no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

What’s this!?!?!  Bounty hunters in the Death Star!

== Notes ==

* Author: 'this deck is classic! No virtual cards! No episode I cards!'.
* Posted 'Come Here You Big Coward!' (under Effects) dested the Special Edition Effect; the author says he isn't allowed to use the shield version.
* Posted 'CC Boba Fett' dested the Cloud City Boba Fett; 'R3-T6' R3-T6 (Arthree-Teesix); 'Mobilization paints' Mobilization Points.

== Strategy ==

First thing you should know before rating is that this deck is classic!  No virtual cards!  No episode I cards!  I know it would be way easier to play come here you big coward shield, but none of my friend will let me!  This deck is based after several different strategies.  The first and most obvious is the death star.  Retract the bridge could go from this deck, but I’m slightly intersected in using it; the rest you all know.  If my opponent is playing land on tatooine or bespin, he will get a present surprise.  The one thing I hate about my friends decks is that they sometimes try to play force drain decks!  Like Degobauh or Yavin 4 packed with jedi and lighsabors.  So if they try that I’ve got come here you big coward; which, they don’t know I have.  Ok, I’m probably boring you right now so let’s get back to my deck.  You may notice I’ve got a rely bounty hunter thing going on here.  Two bounty hunters with lots of interrupts, effects, and weapons to guide them.  I feel this is very efficient for slight ground control.  The imperials and starships control space, and if I need them I can send those officers to aid the bounty office.  I also have several aliens to help out with power.  Niado Duegad can reach eight power if given the right force. Prophetess isn’t so great in power, but I like here four ability in this deck. IF you got any advice that’d be great!  Just remember, it’s classic….
